scope: Correct the examples for the existing ま and あい readings of 間; explain the character-by-character split.

metadata.status: All existing front matter retained; no reading removed or added.

correction.before: 合間 あいま was used to illustrate 間 read あい.
correction.after: Move 合間 to ま, explain 合 (あい) + 間 (ま), and illustrate あい with 間狂言 (あいきょうげん), explicitly marked as specialist theatre vocabulary.

sources.inspected_evidence: Kun readings あいだ, ま and あい; on readings カン and ケン.
sources.supports: Retaining the existing reading metadata despite replacing the incorrect example.

sources.inspected_evidence: Kun readings include あ.い and あい-.
sources.supports: The あい component of 合間 belongs to 合, not 間.

sources.entry: 合間 / あいま, JMdict via Jisho
sources.inspected_evidence: Noun: interval, break, pause, spare moment; also a gap or opening.
sources.supports: The word-reading pair and spare-moment gloss in the ま row.

sources.entry: 合間, Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten
sources.inspected_evidence: Headword segmented あい‐ま; an interval or gap, often temporal.
sources.supports: Segmentation of the whole word and its interval meaning.

sources.entry: 間狂言 / あいきょうげん, JMdict via Jisho
sources.inspected_evidence: Noh-tagged noun: kyogen interlude; short scene during a Noh play performed by a kyogen actor, usually explaining the play.
sources.supports: A genuine example of 間 read あい, with an explicit specialist-theatre qualification.

sources.inspected_evidence: A separate あい headword includes intervals and an abbreviation of 間狂言, with the reading あいきょうげん supplied.
sources.supports: Independent dictionary confirmation of the あい reading and its theatre use.

sources.entry: 間狂言 / あいきょうげん, Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten and Nipponica
sources.inspected_evidence: The Noh sense is the part performed by a kyogen actor. Other senses and historical performance contexts are also listed.
sources.supports: The scoped Noh gloss, without reducing every instance to a comic scene or claiming the word has only one sense.

editorial_limits: The specialist label applies to the chosen 間狂言 example; it does not deny the other documented uses of あい.
No JLPT level is assigned to either example word.
The rest of the kanji card, including its origin paragraph, is outside this correction.
No independent reviewer was used for this bounded correction.
